    public static bool Contains(float key)
    {
        if ((key != key))
        {
         return false;
        }



        int lo = 0;
        int hi = 4;
        while (lo <= hi && key >= _keys[lo] && key <= _keys[hi])
        {
            float loKey = _keys[lo];
            float hiKey = _keys[hi];

            if (loKey == hiKey)
            {
                if (loKey == key)
                    return true;

                break;
            }

            double loValue = (double)loKey;
            double hiValue = (double)hiKey;
            int i = loValue == hiValue
                ? lo + ((hi - lo) >> 1)
                : lo + (int)((((double)key - loValue) * (hi - lo)) / (hiValue - loValue));

            if (i < lo)
                i = lo;
            else if (i > hi)
                i = hi;

            float midKey = _keys[i];
            if (midKey == key)
                return true;
            if (midKey < key)
                lo = i + 1;
            else
                hi = i - 1;
        }

        return false;
    }
